title: Output pivotal count
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $b$ be a sign and $x$ a point of the cube. The output pivotal count is the number of coordinates that are output pivotal for $f$, with respect to $b$ at $x$.

$x$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
